# Samama Tahir

> Samama Tahir is a full-stack web developer and digital growth specialist based in Porto, Portugal, with 8+ years of experience. Work covers WordPress and Shopify websites, custom web applications and plugins, SEO, paid ads and AI automation for small and medium businesses in Porto, Vila Nova de Gaia, across Portugal and internationally (online).

The site is available in English (root) and European Portuguese (/pt/).

## Services

- [All services](https://samamatahir.com/services/)
- [Web Development](https://samamatahir.com/services/web-development/): web design in Portugal. WordPress and Shopify development, custom web applications, e-commerce and API integrations.
  - [Shopify Developer](https://samamatahir.com/services/web-development/shopify-developer/): custom Shopify 2.0 themes, migrations from 1.0 themes to Online Store 2.0, custom sections in Liquid and JavaScript, app integrations and store speed.
  - [WordPress Developer](https://samamatahir.com/services/web-development/wordpress-developer/): custom themes and plugins, page builders, WooCommerce, speed, WordPress SEO and maintenance.
  - [Hire a WordPress Developer](https://samamatahir.com/services/web-development/wordpress-developer/hire/): how hiring works, for UK and US clients.
  - [Online Stores](https://samamatahir.com/services/web-development/online-store/): ecommerce website development on Shopify and WooCommerce.
  - [Custom Web Apps](https://samamatahir.com/services/web-development/custom-web-apps/): React or Vue frontends, Laravel, CodeIgniter or Node.js backends, dashboards and API integrations.
  - [Web Developer in Porto](https://samamatahir.com/web-developer-porto/): for local and English-speaking businesses in Porto.
- [Marketing](https://samamatahir.com/services/marketing/): local SEO, Google Business Profile, Google Ads, Meta Ads, analytics and tracking, conversion optimization.
  - [Local SEO Services](https://samamatahir.com/services/marketing/local-seo/): Google Business Profile, citations, location pages, reviews and tracking for small businesses.
  - [SEO Consultant](https://samamatahir.com/services/marketing/seo-consultant/): technical SEO, content and local SEO, with the fixes implemented.
  - [Google Business Profile](https://samamatahir.com/services/marketing/google-business-profile/): setup, verification help and optimization.
  - [Google Ads](https://samamatahir.com/services/marketing/google-ads/): campaign setup and management with conversion tracking.
  - [Meta Ads](https://samamatahir.com/services/marketing/meta-ads/): Facebook and Instagram ads with pixel and Conversions API.
  - [GA4 and Analytics](https://samamatahir.com/services/marketing/ga4-analytics/): GA4 and Google Tag Manager setup, consent mode, ecommerce events.
- [AI & Automation](https://samamatahir.com/services/ai-automation/): AI chatbots and automated replies, workflow and business process automation, AI-powered reports, API integrations.

Pricing is not listed on the site. Every project gets a written fixed quote after a free 20-minute call.

## Work

- [Portfolio and case studies](https://samamatahir.com/work/): OROS (Shopify 1.0 to 2.0 migration), Fore Fathers (Shopify 2.0 with WordPress for content), Daytrip (custom Shopify 2.0 theme from Figma, Section Rendering API), a custom WordPress plugin connecting Gravity Forms to Advyzon and Wealthbox, and Those Coffee People (performance, QuickBooks integration, technical SEO).
